items.label: Lam Research press release: Lam Research Announces Plans to Invest More than $3B to (08-13-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Lam intends to invest more than $3 billion over the next five years to expand its global R&D lab net

set.signal: Lam intends to invest more than $3 billion over the next five years to expand its global R&D lab network (the network spans the United States, Asia and Europe); the multi-site expansion is expected to increase experiment capacity by more than 50%, and Lam plans to begin expanding this year. The combined lab infrastructure supports more than one million experiments annually, and in recent customer engagements the integrated lab approach shortened process development up to 2.5 times. CEO Tim Archer: 'We are investing with the intention of staying ahead of what our customers need.'

items.reason: The release says the existing lab network spans the US, Asia and Europe; it does not say the $3B expansion sites are in those regions (only 'multi-site expansion'). Clarify the parenthetical.
items.evidence: Lam's global lab network spans the United States, Asia, and Europe. ... The planned multi-site expansion is expected to add infrastructure and capabilities to increase experiment capacity by more than 50%.
